projects.name: WarioWare DIY Mini-Game
description: WarioWare DIY is a game / tool for Nintendo DS that allows you to draw, animate, compose music, and program a microgame.
This year for my birthday, I created one that replicated my experience of getting a commemorative tattoo.
I also asked my closest friends to make microgames as a gift. I wanted to share the experience of making things.
Many of my friends are artists of various mediums and we all agreed that it was very fun to work within the limitations of the tool.

projects.name: Glass Shatter Transition
description: Copies camera buffer to a cell fractured mesh UV mapped as one surface. Then, applies an impulse to simulate an explosion, so it looks like shattering glass,  revealing the underlying scene.
Inspired by VFX in Super Smash Bros & Persona 5.

projects.name: Stencil Buffer Point Lights
description: By writing a sphere volume where it intersects with geometry to the stencil buffer, we can use that as a mask to brighten pixels, creating a simple illusion of point lights in the style of Zelda: The Wind Waker.

projects.name: MipMaps for Style
description: Custom texture with different art for each MipMap level, and a simple shader to create the impression of water.
Using MipMaps to create explicit artistic effects by viewing distance, such as specularity or abstractions, is a powerful & performant tool.

projects.name: Toon Shader
projects.description: Custom Toon Shader for learning purposes with simple implementation of lambertian lighting thresholded by a color ramp texture, specular highlighting by viewing direction & light normal, rim lighting by view direction & surface normal, inverted hull outlines, and shadow casting.

projects.name: Dither by Distance
projects.description: Replicates transparency using dithering patterns and a mesh's distance from the camera for intensity, similar to effects in Super Mario Odyssey and Splatoon.

projects.name: Stripes
projects.description: Stripes drawn using UV tiling, UV displacement by time, toggable smoothstep falloff or harsh step, and sin wave warping.

projects.name: Vector Math & Shapes
description: Vector math examples for game development, including:
• Calculating the dot product of the player's look direction & direction towards the enemy with cone of view threshold
• Entity with a radial trigger based on distance between center points
Drawn using the Shapes library from Freya Holmer

projects.name: Recolor
projects.description: Finds the luminosity of a fragment and samples a 1D color texture to recolor it, very useful for things like player icons, player skins, color palettes, etc.

projects.name: gdx-3ds
description: A port of F-Zero X to the Nintendo 3DS at 60fps in stereoscopic 3D with local & online multiplayer.
I used Claude Code to do deep research on the state of N64 -> 3DS ports, N64 architecture, and 3DS homebrew development. Once a plan was created, we got to work.
Over 3 months of free time, an orchestrator agent ran many sub-agents in parallel to solve issues like memory address translation & converting N64 display lists into native 3DS GPU commands.
Eventually, I removed myself from the loop by using a 3DS connected to Wi-Fi, which the agent would push builds to for testing, autonomously.
I spent $600 on 3 months of Claude Max (~$20k at API rate cost).
I'd estimate the same work would take 4 Sr. Engineers over 1 year (~$500k in salary).
(F-Zero X is © Nintendo. The code is open source, no assets included. This was an education project on low level development, optimization, and autonomous agentic development).
[A full technical breakdown here, and some more personal thoughts on the future of software development](https://hypnotize.works/gdx-3ds/postmortem/cost.html)
Tools: Claude, devkitPro, G-Diffuser

projects.name: Overlap
description: When trying to keep your data organized, directories that bucket on concepts start to fail.
Overlap is a Mac OS app that uses Finder tags to solve this problem. Easily assign files multiple tags and explore your data using an intuitive Venn Diagram query tool.
Built in plugins use Apple's local ML models for image classification (offering suggested tags and ones in your taxonomy), duplicate identification, and multi-modal semantic search.
There's also advanced moodboard support and integration with Are.na
[github](https://github.com/cruxxxxxx/Overlap)
tools: Claude, Swift, CLIP
